items.name: start-1
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, eye level, 28mm. Scene: the entrance forecourt of LANDRI at golden hour. A dark unbadged luxury sedan has just stopped on the sandstone drive; a valet in an ivory jacket holds the rear door open as an elegant Cameroonian couple steps out; the host in a deep-green suit welcomes them near the entrance. The tall carved iroko double doors stand wide open, revealing the warm amber interior with raffia pendant lamps and set tables. Camera at chest height on the drive, centred on the open entrance, inviting the viewer to walk straight in.

items.name: start-2
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, eye level, 28mm, blue hour turning to night. Scene: the arrival court of LANDRI. A black unbadged car is parked at the kerb; a valet in an ivory jacket opens the door for an elegant woman in a long dress while her companion smiles; two more guests walk toward the entrance along a path lit by low bronze lanterns between palms. The wide carved wooden double doors are open; inside glows warm amber. Camera at chest height, centred on the open doors, inviting the viewer in.

items.name: start-3
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, eye level, 24mm, late golden hour. Scene: the front of LANDRI seen from the drop-off lane: sandstone walls, slatted iroko screens, deep bronze-edged roof, tropical garden. A dark unbadged sedan at the curb, a valet holding the door, a smiling family of Cameroonian guests stepping out, the host in a deep-green suit greeting them with a slight bow. Straight ahead the open carved double doors frame the glowing dining room. Camera at chest height centred on the entrance.

items.name: ch-salle
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, eye level, 24mm. Scene: the main dining room of LANDRI in the evening: carved wooden wall panels, large contemporary African paintings, raffia pendant lamps glowing amber, round walnut tables with ivory linen and bronze cutlery, deep green velvet chairs, Ndop cushions on a long banquette, guests dining and talking, a waiter in an ivory jacket pouring water. In the background the long stone pass of the open kitchen with bronze heat lamps.

items.name: ch-cuisine
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, slightly low angle, 28mm. Scene: the open kitchen of LANDRI during service. A Cameroonian chef in a charcoal jacket and dark leather apron finely slices plantain on a wooden board; behind him another chef grills spiced chicken and a whole fish over glowing charcoal; copper pots of sauce simmer with gentle steam; a sous-chef sprinkles ground spices with precise fingers. Stone counters, bronze heat lamps, warm amber light, realistic professional gestures.

items.name: ch-ingredients
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic food commercial still, macro close-up, shallow depth of field. Scene: the ingredient counter of LANDRI's kitchen arranged on dark stone and wood: ripe plantains, yams, cassava, sweet potatoes, fresh red and yellow chillies, ginger roots, roasted peanuts, small bronze bowls of African spices (pebe, penja white pepper, njansang), tomatoes, fresh herbs, a whole fresh fish and large prawns on crushed ice. Warm side light, rich textures, droplets of water.

items.name: ch-dressage
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic macro still, very shallow depth of field. Scene: at the stone pass of LANDRI a chef's hands in a charcoal jacket plate a dish with fine tweezers: placing a micro herb on three glazed grilled prawns resting on a small dome of dark green ndole (bitter leaf and peanut stew) in a deep charcoal stoneware bowl, thin crisp plantain chips standing upright, drops of red chilli oil. Bronze heat lamp glow, a little steam.

items.name: ch-plat
items.prompt: Photorealistic gastronomic hero shot, slow cinematic feel, shallow depth of field. Scene: the finished signature dish of LANDRI centred on a dark walnut table with ivory linen: in a deep charcoal stoneware bowl, a neat dome of dark green ndole (bitter leaf and peanut stew), three glazed grilled prawns, upright crisp plantain chips, drops of red chilli oil, micro herbs, subtle rising steam. Bronze cutlery, a glass of deep red bissap, softly blurred warm restaurant background with amber raffia lamps.

items.name: ch-service
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, eye level, 28mm. Scene: in LANDRI's dining room a waiter in an ivory mandarin-collar jacket sets the signature dish down in front of an elegant Cameroonian woman at a round walnut table; her companion and a friend lean in smiling, one about to take a photo-free first bite with a bronze spoon. Raffia lamps, carved wooden panels, warm amber light, genuine relaxed joy.

items.name: ch-ambiance
items.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic wide shot from a slightly raised position, 24mm. Scene: the whole dining room of LANDRI in full evening service: every table occupied by couples, families and groups of friends, Black Cameroonian, African and international guests laughing and sharing dishes, waiters in ivory jackets moving between tables, the open kitchen with bronze heat lamps at the back, carved wood panels, contemporary African art, raffia lamps glowing amber. Warm, elegant, lively, not staged.
